title: Valve introduces Steam Neural Recommendations, replacing collaborative filtering
content: Valve has quietly rolled out a major update to Steam's discovery algorithm, replacing its decade-old collaborative filtering system with a neural recommendation engine trained on over 500 million player behavior signals. The new system shows significantly different results for niche and mid-tier titles, with some indie developers reporting 30-60% changes in organic traffic within weeks of the rollout. Valve has not published technical details but described the change as 'a more personalized discovery experience.' The update has reignited debate among developers about platform dependency and the opacity of algorithmic distribution.
